A [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] was a '''general''' in the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="End Game" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Readers" /> the [[General/Legends|general]] commanded part of the [[Army/Legends|army]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Rellias]] alongside [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Ganne]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] under the command of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|targeted]] Rellias, intending to capture Ganne and have him lead them to the Gungan [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="End Game" />

The Droid Army arrived on a shore near Rellias and was met with a cavalry charge led by Ganne and the general, who were riding [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]]. Maul used his [[Darth Maul's double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to [[Death/Legends|slaughter]] many Gungans in his path to reach Ganne. When he was five [[Meter/Legends|meters]] from Ganne and the general, Maul [[Force jump/Legends|launched]] himself into the air towards them, decapitating the general and knocking Ganne off his kaadu.<ref name="End Game" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan general appeared in "[[End Game]]," a short story by [[James Luceno]] published in the [[2012]] re-release of the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]].<ref name="End Game" />
